name: moonsize-local
description: Local CLI and report shell for the MoonBit MoonSize core

scripts.test: moon test --target js --deny-warn && npm run build && node --test --test-isolation=none tests/integration.test.mjs tests/worker.test.mjs
scripts.report: node bin/moonsize.mjs diff reports/demo/before.wasm reports/demo/after.wasm --html reports/demo/report.html
